outcome: Volumes of grey and white matter
Physical growth parameters (weight, length, head circumference)
cohort: The cohort consists of neonates born to mothers diagnosed with COVID-19 from two maternal and children's hospitals in Hubei Province, China.
finding: Some neonates born to mothers with COVID-19, particularly those diagnosed with COVID-19 themselves, showed abnormal brain MRI findings, including white matter abnormalities, delayed myelination, and brain dysplasia, but all neonates demonstrated normal physical growth at 44 weeks corrected gestational age.
followup_time: Observation at 44 weeks corrected gestational age
